(begin (define talk-id "053-cityhall-king-talk") (if (!get talk-id) (begin (dialog '(("king/king-1" "{{hero}}!
Nice to meet you, I am ON VII, the king of the Water Region.
I was told you freed Hana's Tunnel from the Hoarfrost Team, thanks a lot!
The tunnel had been blocked for weeks.") ("/hero" "My duty!
By the way, King Xe III gave me this package for you."))) (wait) (take-item "30.package-of-the-king") (dialog '(("king/king-1" "Oh thank you, it's medicine for my back pain.
You know, sitting all day…
Some plants in the Mitsu Forest are miraculous to solve these problems.
Where are you headed?") ("/hero" "I have to go to the Fire Region.") ("king/king-1" "Oh, do you want to leave the region already?
This saddens me.
To go to the Fire Region you have to take a boat that you find west of here.
You need my written permission, here it is."))) (wait) (give-item "53.travel-pass") (dialog '(("/hero" "Thank you!
I will come back sooner or later."))) (wait) (set talk-id #t)) (dialog '(("king/king-1" "In my region you are always welcome.")))))
